raw_meta_yaml:
package:
  name: vounwarp
  version: "1.2"

source:
  url: https://github.com/nghia-vo/vounwarp/archive/1.2.tar.gz
  sha256: 793f7ddd6d927e215b08ca8d7ffb51b1789fffb91b6ce4ac70aff17e870278e1
build:
  number: 5
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} setup.py install --single-version-externally-managed --record=record.txt

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy 
    - scipy
    - scikit-image
    - pillow
    - matplotlib-base
    - h5py
test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - vounwarp   

about:
  home: https://github.com/nghia-vo/vounwarp
  license:  Apache 2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: 'Distortion correction with high-accuracy for tomography detector systems. https://doi.org/10.1364/OE.23.032859 '

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - nghia-vo
